verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features (Seer, Autofix), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, contains no documented AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or training-exclusion control. Self-hosting is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented training-prevention capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
